title: Hate Speech Detection with Generalizable Target-aware Fairness

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring discrepancies in False Positive and False Negative rates (normalized FPED and FNED metrics) across hate speech classifier predictions on posts targeting specific genders (e.g., Male, Female).
Evaluating the performance disparity of hate speech classifiers (using nFPED and nFNED) on posts targeting specific racial groups or origins (e.g., Black, White).
Calculating false positive and false negative equality differences (nFPED, nFNED) to assess classifier fairness on posts targeting religious identity groups (e.g., Christian, Jewish, Muslim).
Assessing algorithmic fairness by comparing False Positive/Negative Equality Differences (nFPED, nFNED) on posts associated with specific sexualities (e.g., Homosexual).
Measuring the disparity in classification error rates (using nFPED and nFNED) for hate speech detection on posts targeting individuals with disabilities or mental illnesses.
Evaluating discrepancies in hate speech classification error rates (nFPED, nFNED) on posts targeting different age groups using the Measuring Hate Speech (MHS) dataset.
